_doc: AUDIENCE-1: every system builds and holds a returning audience. Engine: scripts/audience.py (python3 scripts/audience.py --run --apply, daily in .github/workflows/audience.yml). A section is any content this system publishes; give each the producer that keeps it fresh. Promotion goes only to accounts this system owns, within its social gate; opt-outs and platform rules always win. Follower handles are public profiles, read without a credential.

sections.producer: the merge lane (every merged change is an entry)

metrics.remedy: a section published nothing in the window: run its producer
one section carries nearly everything: publish in the quiet ones
too little new content: run the producers on their clocks
nothing new recently: run the stale section's producer
new items with no post: queue one per item on the social calendar
readers look but do not act: put the hook (quiz, tool, live result) on the pages they land on and make finishing it rewarding
readers leave after one page: link pages to related ones
no one polls the feed: link it from every page
followers fell: check the posting loop ran

hooks.why: the one thing this system lets a reader do and see the result of; rename it to the system's own hook
